title: Dots   Line
description: An interesting puzzle in the Connect the dots genre. On intelligence and ingenuity. Connect the lines without lifting your hands; you cannot draw along the same line twice. If you liked this game, I would appreciate your support! Just write a positive review and tell us what inspired you about it! What needs to be added or removed in the game, write too! 1 Connect the lines without lifting your hands. 2 You cannot draw along the same line twice. 3 A game of intelligence and ingenuity. A puzzle game in the Connect the dots genre. The goal is to connect all the points with lines without drawing the same line twice.
